lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਖੋਈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)darahu duramat doojee khoee so jan har liv laagaa ||
lines.translation: One who eliminates evil-mindedness and duality from within himself, that humble being lovingly focuses his mind on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau kripaa keenee merai suaamee tin anadin har gun gaae ||
lines.translation: Those, upon whom my Lord and Master bestows His Grace, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਭੀਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sun man bheene sahaj subhaae ||2||
lines.translation: Hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am intuitively drenched with His Love. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jug mahi raam naam nisataaraa ||
lines.translation: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur te upajai sabad veechaaraa ||
lines.translation: Contemplative meditation on the Word of the Shabad emanates from the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabad veechaaraa raam naam piaaraa jis kirapaa kare s paae ||
lines.translation: Contemplating the Guru's Shabad, one comes to love the Lord's Name; he alone obtains it, unto whom the Lord shows Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje gun gaavai din raatee kilavikh sabh gavaae ||
lines.translation: In peace and poise, he sings the Lord's Praises day and night, and all sins are eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko teraa too sabhanaa kaa hau teraa too hamaaraa ||
lines.translation: All are Yours, and You belong to all. I am Yours, and You are mine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jug mahi raam naam nisataaraa ||3||
lines.translation: In this age, emancipation comes only from the Lord's Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਆਇ ਵੁਠੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan aai vuthe ghar maahee ||
lines.translation: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaavahi tripat aghaahee ||
lines.translation: singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied and fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun gaai sadaa tripataasee phir bhookh na laagai aae ||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, one is satisfied forever, never to feel hunger again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪੂਜ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dah dis pooj hovai har jan kee jo har har naam dhiaae ||
lines.translation: That humble servant of the Lord, who meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is worshipped in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har aape joR vichhoRe har bin ko doojaa naahee ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He Himself joins and separates; there is no other than the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਆਇ ਵੁਠੇ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saajan aai vuthe ghar maahee ||4||1||
lines.translation: The Lord, my Friend has come to dwell within the home of my heart. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 3 ghar 3 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa kee har jeeu raakhai jug jug rakhadaa aaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord protects His humble devotees; throughout the ages, He has protected them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: so bhagat jo guramukh hovai haumai sabad jalaaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Those devotees who become Gurmukh burn away their ego, through the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai sabad jalaaiaa mere har bhaaiaa jis dee saachee baanee ||
lines.translation: Those who burn away their ego through the Shabad, become pleasing to my Lord; their speech becomes True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee bhagat karahi din raatee guramukh aakh vakhaanee ||
lines.translation: They perform the Lord's true devotional service, day and night, as the Guru has instructed them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਚਾਲ ਸਚੀ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa kee chaal sachee at niramal naam sachaa man bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The devotees' lifestyle is true, and absolutely pure; the True Name is pleasing to their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat sohahi dar saachai jinee sacho sach kamaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the those devotees, who practice Truth, and only Truth, look beauteous in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa kee jaat pat hai bhagat har kai naam samaane raam ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the social class and honor of His devotees; the Lord's devotees merge in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਵਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਪਛਾਣੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagat karahi vichahu aap gavaavahi jin gun avagan pachhaane raam ||
lines.translation: They worship the Lord in devotion, and eradicate self-conceit from within themselves; they understand merits and demerits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਭੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun augan pachhaanai har naam vakhaanai bhai bhagat meethee laagee ||
lines.translation: They understand merits and demerits, and chant the Lord's Name; devotional worship is sweet to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin bhagat karahi din raatee ghar hee mahi bairaagee ||
lines.translation: Night and day, they perform devotional worship, day and night, and in the home of the self, they remain detached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatee raate sadaa man niramal har jeeu vekhahi sadaa naale ||
lines.translation: Imbued with devotion, their minds remain forever immaculate and pure; they see their Dear Lord always with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak se bhagat har kai dar saache anadin naam samhaale ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those devotees are True in the Court of the Lord; night and day, they dwell upon the Naam. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh bhagat karahi bin satigur vin satigur bhagat na hoee raam ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs practice devotional rituals without the True Guru, but without the True Guru, there is no devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੋਗਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maaiaa rog viaape mar janamahi dukh hoee raam ||
lines.translation: They are afflicted with the diseases of egotism and Maya, and they suffer the pains of death and rebirth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਰਜ ਵਿਗੋਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mar janamahi dukh hoee doojai bhaai paraj vigoee vin gur tat na jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: The world suffers the pains of death and rebirth, and through the love of duality, it is ruined; without the Guru, the essence of reality is not known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat vihoonaa sabh jag bharamiaa a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Without devotional worship, everyone in the world is deluded and confused, and in the end, they depart with regrets.
